points.description: Gives the core learning step: initialise the weights (randomly) and update them with the perceptron rule Δw = η·x(n) for a labelled point that is misclassified (the model answer's condition ⟨w,x⟩ ≤ 0). The labels must be +/- (positive and negative).
points.partial_credit: Half for the update rule stated without the misclassification condition, or for initialisation and labels without the update rule.

points.description: Gives the repetition and stopping idea: the update is repeated over all training points in epochs until the weights stop changing (much), and states that this converges because the data is linearly separable.
points.partial_credit: Half for repeating over epochs without a stopping condition, or for stating convergence without the repetition.

rubric.notes: Award full marks to P1 when the student gives initialisation of weights, labelling with +/- and the update Δw = η·x(n) applied to a misclassified point, and to P2 when the student repeats the update over epochs until the weights stop changing, with a note that linear separability gives convergence. Give half marks for a correct idea that is vague or missing one element, such as the update without its condition or repetition without a stopping rule. Give no marks for a wrong update, an off-topic answer or an empty answer. Accept pseudo-code or a numbered list in any syntax, as the steps and their order matter more than the syntax.
